description: This file defines the ApplyTokenParser class in the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing the 'apply' tag that applies filters to sections of templates.

classes.name: ApplyTokenParser
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTokenParser, responsible for parsing the 'apply' tag in Twig templates, applying filters on template sections.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'apply' tag in the template, returning Nodes that represent the filter application logic.

methods.name: decideApplyEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token signals the end of the 'apply' block by testing for 'endapply'.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the name of the tag this parser handles, which is 'apply'.
